g.text: 1. POWER SUPPLY & BURN-PROOF 5V ISOLATION (2S LiPo 7.4V + 5V 3A UBEC)
7.4V-8.4V LiPo NEVER touches ESP32 or Pi Zero W!
Only feeds Feetech Servo Pin 2 & Buck IN+.
IN- & OUT- share common ground plane
Feeds 15x Feetech HD-1910M Pin 2 (VCC) via 3x 3A PTC Fuses + 3x 220uF 25V Caps
3. HIGH-LEVEL BRAIN: RASPBERRY PI ZERO W (v1.1) (WHISTLE S2T + NEEDLE 3 + 30 RL ZOO)
U3: RASPBERRY PI ZERO W (v1.1) — 512MB RAM + 16GB+ MICROSD
BCM2835 1GHz ARMv6 · 802.11n Wi-Fi · Runs Whistle S2T + Needle 3 + 30 RL Policies!
PI ZERO W v1.1 MEMORY BUDGET (FITS 100%!)
• Whistle S2T (`whistle_d4.cact`): 14.5 MB SD / ~32 MB RAM
• 30 RL Policies (`*.npz`): 11.8 MB SD / ~25 MB RAM
• Raspberry Pi OS Lite Headless: ~45 MB RAM
Total Disk: 41.3 MB / 16,000 MB (0.3% of SD card!)
Total RAM : ~130 MB / 512 MB (382 MB RAM Free!)
ESP32 Bridge Firmware: 310 KB / 4 MB Flash (7.5%)
HOW PI ZERO W (v1.1) + ESP32 DEVKIT V1 DIVIDE THE WORKLOAD:
1. ESP32 DevKit V1 (4MB Flash): Polls 15x Feetech 1910 servos @ 1Mbps + IMU @ 100Hz, and streams 16kHz I2S mic audio when PTT is held.
2. Raspberry Pi Zero W v1.1 (512MB RAM): Runs 50Hz Pure-NumPy RL policy (`pi_zero_client.py`) AND runs Cactus Whistle + Needle 3!
3. Why does Whistle + Needle 3 never slow down the 50Hz walking loop? Voice transcription only runs while you hold/release PTT
(when the duck is standing waiting for your command), or can be offloaded to your PC over Wi-Fi UDP HIL (`--hil-port 9528`).
• Zero-Soldering Option: Connect Pi Zero W "USB" OTG port directly to ESP32 Micro-USB (`/dev/ttyUSB0`) for both power & 921600-baud data!
ELECTRICAL SPECIFICATIONS, JST / MOLEX SERVO BUS MAP & ASSEMBLY RULES
DUAL-HEADER ESP32 ARCHITECTURE (ZERO STRAPPING / ADC / UART CONFLICTS):
• LEFT HEADER = VOICE MIC & POWER: INMP441 I2S Mic (D25 SCK, D26 WS, D33 SD), PTT Button (D27), VBAT ADC1 (D34), +5V_MAIN (VIN).
• RIGHT HEADER = ROBOTS & SENSORS: Feetech 1Mbps Bus (D17 TX2, D16 RX2), 6-DOF IMU I2C (D22 SCL, D21 SDA), Pi Zero W UART0 (TX0/RX0).
• 100% Clean Boot: Strapping pins GPIO0, GPIO2, GPIO12, GPIO15 are never pulled to invalid boot states during reset.
• CN1 [BATT_XT30] (2-Pin): Pin 1 = +7.4V_VBAT (2S LiPo+), Pin 2 = Battery GND (-)
• P1 [LEFT_LEG_BUS] (3-Pin): Pin 1 = FEETECH_DATA_1M, Pin 2 = +7.4V_SERVO (F1 3A), Pin 3 = GND --> Servo IDs 10, 11, 12, 13, 14
• P2 [RIGHT_LEG_BUS] (3-Pin): Pin 1 = FEETECH_DATA_1M, Pin 2 = +7.4V_SERVO (F2 3A), Pin 3 = GND --> Servo IDs 20, 21, 22, 23, 24
• P3 [HEAD_BEAK_BUS] (3-Pin): Pin 1 = FEETECH_DATA_1M, Pin 2 = +7.4V_SERVO (F3 3A), Pin 3 = GND --> Servo IDs 30, 31, 32, 33, 34
• J_IMU [TRUNK_IMU] (4-Pin): Pin 1 = +3V3, Pin 2 = GND, Pin 3 = IMU_SDA (GPIO21), Pin 4 = IMU_SCL (GPIO22)
• J_MIC [WHISTLE_I2S] (5-Pin): Pin 1 = +3V3, Pin 2 = GND (tie L/R), Pin 3 = MIC_SCK (D25), Pin 4 = MIC_WS (D26), Pin 5 = MIC_SD (D33)
CIRCUIT PROTECTION, SERVO ID MAP & DECOUPLING HEADROOM:
• Left Leg (P1): ID 10 (hip_yaw, 0°), ID 11 (hip_roll, -5°), ID 12 (hip_pitch, -22°), ID 13 (knee, 0°), ID 14 (ankle, +22°)
• Right Leg (P2): ID 20 (hip_yaw, 0°), ID 21 (hip_roll, +5°), ID 22 (hip_pitch, +22°), ID 23 (knee, 0°), ID 24 (ankle, -22°)
• Head/Beak (P3): ID 30 (neck_pitch, +20°), ID 31 (head_pitch, +20°), ID 32 (head_yaw, 0°), ID 33 (head_roll, 0°), ID 34 (mouth, 0°..30°)
• Bulk Capacitors C21/C23/C25 (3x 220uF 25V): Placed across +7.4V_SERVO & GND at P1/P2/P3 to absorb 15-servo dynamic torque spikes.
• Voltage Divider R4 (30kOhm) / R5 (10kOhm) to GPIO34 (ADC1_6): Scales 8.4V LiPo down to 2.10V so ESP32 monitors battery voltage safely.
CRITICAL ASSEMBLY & CALIBRATION RULES (READ BEFORE POWER-ON):
1. ADJUST MINI360 / MP1584 FIRST: Before connecting ESP32 or Pi Zero W, turn trimpot until OUT+ measures 5.10V DC on a multimeter.
2. ASSIGN SERVO IDs ONE-BY-ONE: Every new Feetech HD-1910M ships as ID 1. Plug ONE servo at a time into the bus and use the Web UI
(`http://127.0.0.1:9527` -> Servo Setup) to set IDs 10..14, 20..24, 30..34 and center horn at raw count 2047 before daisy-chaining!
3. CHECK 3-PIN SERVO POLARITY: Pin 1 = SIGNAL (White/Yellow), Pin 2 = +7.4V_SERVO (Red, Center!), Pin 3 = GND (Black/Brown).
4. IMU ORIENTATION: Mount QMI8658A / MPU6050 flat in the trunk base (+X Forward, +Y Left, +Z Up) for accurate 50Hz gravity projection.
5. WHISTLE S2T + NEEDLE 3 ON PI ZERO W: Both `whistle_d4.cact` (14.5MB) and `duck_4l.cact` (15MB) use `.cact` v4 CQ2/CQ4 weights
and run via `whistle-esp32`'s C/NumPy engine on the Pi Zero W v1.1 (or on your PC over Wi-Fi HIL for <100ms GPU/CPU voice response).
6. OPTIONAL SPEAKER: You can also add a MAX98357A I2S DAC Amp on ESP32 GPIO18 (BCLK), GPIO19 (LRC), GPIO5 (DIN) for quack audio!
2. MCU (LEFT = POWER, MIC & ADC | RIGHT = SERVO BUS, IMU & PI ZERO W UART)

svg.text: RIGHT: 1Mbps SERVO BUS, IMU & PI UART
LEFT: Mic, PTT & Power (Pins 1,2,6,7,8,9,12) | RIGHT: Servos, IMU & Pi (Pins 1,2,4,5,6,7,11,12,13,14)

g.text: 4. 1 Mbps HALF-DUPLEX SERVO BUS & 15x FEETECH HD-1910M ACTUATOR CHAINS
HALF-DUPLEX 1,000,000 BAUD TTL BUS TRANSCEIVER (DIY 2-RESISTOR OR LUWU SN74LVC1G126/125)
P1: LEFT LEG SERVO DAISY-CHAIN (5x HD-1910M · F1=3A, C21=220uF)
P2: RIGHT LEG SERVO DAISY-CHAIN (5x HD-1910M · F2=3A, C23=220uF)
P3: HEAD, NECK & BEAK CHAIN (5x HD-1910M · F3=3A, C25=220uF)
5. 6-DOF TRUNK IMU (I2C) & CACTUS WHISTLE I2S VOICE MIC + PTT BUTTON
U5: INMP441 I2S DIGITAL MICROPHONE (CACTUS WHISTLE S2T)
• L/R pin tied to GND = Left Ch
• Runs on Pi Zero W (14.5MB SD)
Fits 100% in Pi Zero W 512MB RAM!
SW2: MOMENTARY PUSH-TO-TALK VOICE BUTTON (D27 / INTERNAL PULL-UP)
TITLE: MICRODUCK / XGO-DUCK — MAIN SYSTEM SCHEMATIC
PROJECT: Microduck Embodied RL Robot (EasyEDA Standard)
SYSTEM: ESP32 DEVKIT V1 + PI ZERO W
